name: synthetic-tender-v1
description: Synthetic bilingual-query benchmark with no personal or confidential data.
pages: Submission deadline: 20 August 2026 at 10:00 UTC. Applications received later will not be considered.
Maximum budget: 1 000 000 RUB including all taxes, delivery costs, and mandatory fees.
Penalty: 0.1% of the contract value for each day of delay, capped at 10% of the contract value.
Supplier must provide a valid ISO 9001 certificate and proof of three completed projects.
Payment is made within 30 calendar days after the customer signs the acceptance certificate.
Contract duration is 180 calendar days from the date of signing.
Warranty period: 36 months from the date the equipment is accepted by the customer.
Questions about the procurement must be submitted through the electronic procurement platform.
